discussion:
# Principle

Systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) are administered in a secure, accountable and auditable manner.

# Indicators of Good Practice

Not effective:
- Privileged access is standing and does not require explicit activation or time-bound grants, excluding approved break-glass and emergency access accounts.
- No re-authentication or step-up authentication is required before privileged sessions.

Partially effective:
- Time-bound access is implemented for some privileged roles but standing access remains for others.
- Session duration limits exist but are not consistently enforced or are set excessively long.

Fully effective:
- Time-bound privilege grants are enforced for applicable privileged roles, with defined maximum session durations and approved emergency access arrangements.
- Re-authentication or step-up authentication is required before privilege activation.
- All privilege activations are logged with activating user, role and timeframes.
title: Enforce explicit session establishment controls before privileged actions are permitted, including the use of time-bound privilege grants.
